propertyDescription: A declared protective right must remain preserved across both reviewed serialized orderings when both actions are jointly enabled and the guarantee applies.

activationWitness.description: The reviewed safe control exercises both serialized orderings with the protective-right predicate evaluated in both outcomes.

mutations.description: Introduce a state/time overlap in which protective and competing actions are jointly enabled.
Make the two serialized orderings terminate in distinct economic outcomes.
Mark the protective right as defeated in the competing-action-first ordering.

scope: Repository-owned reviewed specification benchmark; not a claim of exhaustive source mutation coverage.
